versions.subject: Create lnx_privileged_user_creation.yml
versions.detection:
selection_new_user|contains:
    - 'new user'
selection_uids_gids|contains:
    - 'GID=0' # root group
    - 'UID=0' # root UID
    - 'GID=10' # wheel group
    - 'GID=27' # sudo group
condition: all of selection*
